metadata.case_name: YAN FAI WAH v. KONG SEUNG CHUEN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Amputation of left thumb at the middle position of distal phalanx
source: his left thumb was amputated by the saw at the middle position of distal phalanx.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of thumb

injuries.description: Degenerative changes and mild subluxation over the metacarpal joint
source: Degenerative changes and mild subluxation were subsequently found over the metacarpal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation of metacarpophalangeal joint of finger

manifestations.description: loss of distal to interphalangeal joint
loss of active motion of the said joint
hyperaesthesia on touching and percussing stump end
difficulty in handling and picking up fine objects such as screws and pins
stiffness of the remaining stump of the thumb
pain when thumb accidentally hits against any object (pain lasting a few minutes)
pain in the thumb when there is a drop in temperature

treatments_received: Emergency operation (attempt to replant failed) and stump closure

losses.description: Amputation of left thumb resulting in loss of distal interphalangeal joint, loss of active motion, hyperaesthesia, stiffness, numbness and weakened left hand grip.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in holding a newspaper or a book for very long, difficulty in holding a bowl of rice close to mouth, and difficulty in picking up a glass of water with the left hand.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsang Chin Keung v. Lo Tat Kong trading as Hung Kwong Glass Works & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: plaintiff sustained injury to the upper part of his left (preferred) hand from an electric saw... large deep cut to the thumb at an angle across the inside of the fleshy part of the hand. He suffered from loss of sensation and numbness in left hand, loss of strength in the hand, constant pain, occasional throbbing and loss of sensation in the left forearm at the site of the nerve graft.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ma Kam Yeung v. Fu Hay Kin & Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: left thumb almost amputated by bench-mounted circular saw, re-attached in emergency operation; 60% impairment of thumb and 13% disability of whole person
